ambiguities.issue: No approved detection deadlines for drive-start fault, divert travel verification, jam timeout, or sensor plausibility (R-11,R-13,R-14,R-19). Spec marks TBD.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Record timestamps and durations as evidence; score related verdicts as inconclusive/exploratory until engineer freezes thresholds.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Scoring pass/fail without agreed time limits would invent acceptance criteria.

ambiguities.issue: Late/conflicting route policy after reachable decision point, especially late-B (R-05). Spec says do not retroactively count but exact PLC use of reachable route vs runout is TBD.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Require correct actual-exit routing and RouteComplete disposition matching observed exit; mark late-route alarm expectation as exploratory.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Prevents false pass for rewritten history or missed misroute.

ambiguities.issue: Blocked A/B and blocked runout response policy (R-06,R-07) is proposed exception + runout / feed-inhibit + belt stop, awaiting approval.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Treat as PROBE: check no blocked exit counted as sorted and no blind divert; mark policy conformance inconclusive pending approval.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Demo policy is not a universal conveyor rule.

ambiguities.issue: Sensor debounce threshold and injection method for bounce (R-09) and stuck-PE timeout (R-10) are TBD.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Inject characterized bounce/stuck sequences; require no duplicate count/completion; mark debounce compliance exploratory.

ambiguities.issue: Which WCS/link irregularities must alarm in PLC vs harness merely reports is a review decision (R-08,R-20).
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Require no duplicate carton/completion and visible link state; do not require one generic alarm.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Avoid assuming a single required PLC alarm.

ambiguities.issue: PLC task period, OPC UA sampling/publishing, write-to-application latency, output-observation latency, jitter, drops, staleness, and sub-100ms bounce handling via stimulus queue are unmeasured.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Configure and record all timing in first proof; label stale evidence; mark affected tests inconclusive on disconnect/interruption.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Cannot claim scan-synchronous mirroring; CODESYS default 100ms sampling may hide fast edges.

ambiguities.issue: Operator command pulse/ack method, BenchHeartbeatSeen timeout, Bench_HostHeartbeat/ModeRequest types, State_Code enum values, Fault_Code list, and I/O map OPC UA paths are TBD.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Use mapped surrogate symbols for first proof; fail setup visibly on missing/mistyped/stale tags; record versions.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Prevents silent substitution and HMI/WCS misinterpretation.

ambiguities.issue: Two cartons in flight capable but deferrable; multi-carton divert contention and identity merge policy (R-23) is stretch/PROBE.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Cap first proof at one carton; keep two-carton support as exploratory with per-carton identity tracking.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Avoid scoring unready PLC slice on spacing/queue.

ambiguities.issue: Analog/diagnostic signals Belt_SpeedActual, Drive_Current, D1/D2_Position, Encoder_Count not required unless controller uses them.
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: Do not make them required for first proof; derive motion from Motor_RunCmd + Drive_RunningFB Boolean contract.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Prevents mandatory signals the controller ignores.

ambiguities.issue: HMI vision operation vs direct operator symbols; stale/unknown quality display (UI-01..UI-04,R-22).
ambiguities.safeTemporaryTreatment: If vision cut, drive via operator symbols and label report HMI not visually tested; congruence still checked via State_Code/mode.
ambiguities.whyItMatters: Keeps live I/O validation unblocked while honest about HMI coverage.

assumptions.consequence: World must model entry, D1-approach, DIV-01, D2-approach, DIV-02, runout, plus Exit A and Exit B branches; one carton baseline, capable of two.
assumptions.statement: Machine is one infeed/main lane, one powered belt, two sequential two-position diverts, straight runout jackpot.

assumptions.consequence: Oracle must use actual divert position at decision point; requested route never overrides physics.
assumptions.statement: Cartons follow actual actuator position at decision point, with nonzero travel time; sensors derived from geometric occupancy.

assumptions.consequence: Runout disposition depends on assignment history, not just position.
assumptions.statement: Unassigned carton at runout is normal runout-unassigned; A/B-assigned carton at runout is misrouted.

assumptions.consequence: World freezes positions on Stop/fault-stop; feed gate closes; Reset alone never restarts belt.
assumptions.statement: Operator Stop removes Motor_RunCmd expectation, halts cartons in place without draining, inhibits new feed; Reset only acknowledges cleared fault.

assumptions.consequence: World keeps ground-truth fault state separate from DI/WCS observations sent to PLC.
assumptions.statement: Plant owns physical truth; PLC owns commands; Muse injects faults/non-ideal inputs but report distinguishes injected truth from PLC-observable evidence.

assumptions.consequence: First proof timing values are for visualization/modeling, not pass/fail limits.
assumptions.statement: Suggested 0.30m carton, 0.50m/s belt, 0.35s divert travel, >=0.8m spacing are visualization defaults, not acceptance thresholds until checked against task/transport.

assumptions.consequence: Exploratory verdicts check no false sorted claim and no blind divert; policy approval still required before MUST scoring.
assumptions.statement: Demo defaults: misroute is visible exception without auto belt-stop; blocked A/B goes to runout with exception; blocked runout with no destination inhibits feed and stops belt before congestion.

assumptions.consequence: Motion integration uses fixed-step tick reading last observed PLC outputs; no autonomous clock moves cartons when drive feedback is false.
assumptions.statement: Belt motion requires observed Motor_RunCmd AND modeled Drive_RunningFB true; Drive_RunningFB itself is delayed response to command unless suppressed by fault.

assumptions.consequence: Layout distances beyond carton length/speed/travel are assumed for geometry and must be recorded as model version, not spec facts.
assumptions.statement: Longitudinal positions of PE-ENTRY, PE-D1-APPROACH window, DIV-01 decision, PE-D2-APPROACH window, DIV-02 decision, PE-RUNOUT, PE-EXIT-A/B are assumed configuration to make decision windows and actuation lead-time testable.

assumptions.consequence: Interceptor defaults to hardware passthrough; bench must explicitly select simulated inputs via Bench_ModeRequest and confirm BenchSimulationActive.
assumptions.statement: PLC-side interceptor/instrumentation plus OPC UA transport is decided architecture; one-scan apparent delay is target not guarantee; disconnect marks quality invalid and stops new virtual cartons.

executiveAssessment: Coherent reactive world for v0.5 demo: one belt, two diverts, runout; physics gated by observed PLC drive/divert commands and modeled feedback delays; routing by actual divert position; WCS offer/ack/completion with late/duplicate handling; explicit fault ground-truth vs PLC observation split; all TBD thresholds scored inconclusive. First live proof (A-sort, B-sort, unassigned runout, failed-divert or bounce, plus agent-chosen contradiction) via surrogate validates execution contract only, not real PLC integration.

actions: Select bench simulation, request Auto, command Start
Observe Motor_RunCmd and Drive_RunningFB, release one carton, let it travel mid-lane
Command operator Stop, hold 2s, observe feed gate and positions
Command Reset if faulted, observe no auto-restart, then Start to resume
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if Stop removes Motor_RunCmd expectation, Drive_RunningFB goes false, positions frozen, ReleaseReady indicates not ready, no drain-to-empty and no auto-restart after Reset; else FAIL. Requires PLC output evidence, not model expectation.
experiments.hypothesis: Stop freezes the line and inhibits feed without draining.
observations: Observed Motor_RunCmd, Drive_RunningFB with timestamps/quality
Carton position trace frozen during stop
ReleaseReady / BenchSimulationActive / State_Code
Count deltas
possibleFollowUps: If belt coasts in model but PLC removed command, probe Drive stop-delay parameter vs PLC stop logic
If feed still allowed, follow with feed-gate interlock contradiction test
preconditions: BenchSimulationActive true, Auto, belt running, one carton on belt
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on stop/remove-command/freeze/no-drain. Timing duration recorded, not scored against invented limit.

actions: WCS CartonOffer route A with unique seq/item, await OfferAck
Release one carton at entry when ReleaseReady and spacing OK
Observe D1_ExtendCmd vs D1 home/extended feedback and PE-D1-APPROACH/PE-EXIT-A edges
Collect RouteComplete and counts
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if D1 actually extended before decision point, single PE-EXIT-A passage, RouteComplete sorted A, Count_ExitA +1, no B/runout passage, no misroute. If carton reaches runout, require misrouted not A completion.
experiments.hypothesis: A-assigned carton is diverted at DIV-01 by actual extended position in time.
observations: D1_ExtendCmd, D1_HomeFB/D1_ExtendedFB, PE edges with timestamps
RouteComplete item/route/exit/disposition
Count_ExitA/B/Runout/Misroute
possibleFollowUps: If D1 late but PLC claimed A sorted at runout, follow with EXP-R13-D1FAIL misroute accountability
If D1 oscillates, follow with bounce/debounce probe EXP-R09-BOUNCE
preconditions: Auto, exits ready, D1 healthy, no pending offer
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on correct exit + single count + disposition. Actuation lead-time recorded; no invented ms threshold enforced.

actions: WCS CartonOffer route B, await OfferAck
Release one carton, observe it passes DIV-01 home, then D2 extends before D2 decision
Observe PE-D2-APPROACH/PE-EXIT-B and RouteComplete
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if D1 stayed home at D1 point, D2 actually extended at D2 point, single B completion, Count_ExitB +1. Runout arrival with B assignment is misroute FAIL of sort.
experiments.hypothesis: B-assigned carton passes D1 and diverts at DIV-02.
observations: D1/D2 commands and feedbacks, PE sequence ENTRY->D1APP->D2APP->EXITB
RouteComplete and counts
possibleFollowUps: If D2 late, branch to EXP-R14-D2FAIL
If D1 spuriously extends for B, branch to command/feedback disagreement probe
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on path and counts. Travel/timing recorded only.

actions: Release one carton with no offer or Unknown route while runout ready
Observe it passes both diverts home to PE-RUNOUT
Collect RouteComplete
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if straight to runout, disposition runout-unassigned, Count_Runout +1, no machine fault-stop solely for unroutable carton.
experiments.hypothesis: Unassigned carton normally runs out without faulting the line.
observations: PE-ENTRY/D1APP/D2APP/RUNOUT sequence, divert home feedbacks
RouteComplete disposition, State_Code stays Auto
possibleFollowUps: If PLC fault-stops on unassigned, follow with fault-policy interview and blocked-runout probe
If WCS silence handling differs, follow with link-loss probe
preconditions: Auto, runout ready, no route assigned
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on normal runout disposition and no fault-stop for this cause.

actions: Release A-assigned carton, deliver CartonOffer A only after D1 decision point passed (or change A->B in transit)
Observe actual exit and RouteComplete; check PLC does not overwrite history after divert passage
experiments.decisionLogic: Exploratory PASS requires no retroactive successful-A claim; acceptable is reachable-route or runout with truthful disposition. Any A-sorted claim when carton physically went to runout/B is FAIL of honesty.
experiments.hypothesis: Late/conflicting route cannot rewrite recorded outcome.
observations: Offer timing vs D1/D2 decision timestamps, actual exit, RouteComplete before/after
Active_ItemId/Active_Route observers
possibleFollowUps: If PLC accepts late A and miscounts, follow with duplicate/conflict WCS test
If PLC holds for late route and jams line, follow with jam-timeout probe
preconditions: Auto, one carton in flight, controllable WCS delay
experiments.verdictLimits: PROBE: verdict inconclusive on exact late-B policy (TBD); fail only on demonstrably false sorted claim or double completion.

actions: Set ExitA_Ready false before D1 decision for A-assigned carton; separately test blocked runout with unroutable carton approaching
Observe divert commands, actual exit, RouteComplete, feed/belt response
experiments.decisionLogic: PROBE: blocked A/B must never count as successful A/B; proposed runout-with-exception acceptable pending approval. Blocked runout with no destination: proposed feed-inhibit + belt stop before congestion acceptable pending approval. Blind divert into blocked exit is FAIL.
experiments.hypothesis: Blocked destinations divert to safe alternative or hold, never counted as sorted.
observations: ExitA/B/Runout_Ready driven values, actual exit, counts, MachineStatus availability, ReleaseReady/hold
possibleFollowUps: If PLC diverts into blocked exit, follow with accumulation/jam test
If PLC deadlocks without hold indication, follow with HMI fault-text check
preconditions: Auto, ability to toggle readiness bits per scenario
experiments.verdictLimits: PROBE: policy confirmation required before MUST scoring; verdict inconclusive/exploratory except false-count which is FAIL.

actions: Send duplicate CartonOffer same seq/item twice; also resend after ack
Attempt release; observe carton count, OfferAck behavior, completions
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if no second carton and no second completion; duplicate seq echoed without creating new item.
observations: WCS offer/ack log, feeder releases, RouteComplete count
possibleFollowUps: If duplicate creates carton, follow with conflicting-route same-item test to check identity merge
preconditions: WCS emulator single unacked offer rule

actions: Inject 30-80ms repeated edges on PE-ENTRY or PE-D1-APPROACH during approach (characterized burst)
Observe item creation, divert decision stability, counts
experiments.decisionLogic: PROBE: require no duplicate item/completion and stable divert decision. No threshold scored until debounce spec frozen.
experiments.hypothesis: Bounce does not duplicate items or destabilize divert.
observations: Injected edge list vs PLC-observed DI edges with OPC UA timestamps, Active_ItemId stability
possibleFollowUps: If duplicates appear, follow with stuck-PE and impossible-sequence probes to isolate counting vs edge logic
If OPC UA sampling hides bounce, follow with PLC-side stimulus-queue fallback check
preconditions: Auto, one carton approaching, bounce injector armed
experiments.verdictLimits: PROBE/exploratory: threshold and injection method TBD; verdict inconclusive unless double-count observed which is FAIL of no-double-count.

actions: Suppress Drive_RunningFB despite Motor_RunCmd true; separately assert Drive_Overload mid-travel
Observe fault detection, motion freeze, completions, Reset behavior
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS if drive-start fault raised with no virtual motion and no false completion; overload removes Motor_RunCmd, stops feed, shows fault, no auto-restart after Reset. Deadline TBD so timing recorded.
experiments.hypothesis: Loss of feedback or overload is detected, motion inhibited, no false completion.
observations: Motor_RunCmd vs Drive_RunningFB vs Drive_Overload, position trace, Fault_Code/Active, State_Code
possibleFollowUps: If motion continues without feedback, follow with command/feedback disagreement probe
If auto-restart after Reset, follow with stop-policy audit
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on fault/motion/completion/no-autorestart; detection deadline recorded but not scored (TBD).

actions: Assign A (then separately B), jam D1 (D2) home or neither-limit despite extend command
Let carton run to runout, observe RouteComplete and fault indication
experiments.decisionLogic: PASS requires runout arrival reported as misrouted, not A/B completion; fault indication recorded. Deadline TBD.
experiments.hypothesis: Failed divert yields truthful misroute, not false sort.
observations: Extend commands vs home/extended feedbacks, actual exit PE-RUNOUT, RouteComplete misrouted, Fault_Code
possibleFollowUps: If PLC claims A/B sorted at runout, FAIL sort and follow with contradictory-limits probe
If no fault ever raised, follow with extended travel-time vs feedback plausibility probe
experiments.verdictLimits: MUST on misroute-not-sorted; fault deadline TBD so timing inconclusive.

actions: Assert D1 Home+Extended true together; with one carton assert A+B or A+runout PEs together; report exit-before-entry or D1APP-to-impossible-exit jump
Observe PLC diagnostic response and counts
experiments.decisionLogic: PROBE: require no false verified-divert claim and no double completion/count; expose inconsistency. Exact alarm behavior TBD.
experiments.hypothesis: Contradictory/impossible combinations are exposed without false verification.
observations: Injected vs observed DI, Fault_Code/text, HMI fault view, counts (must not double-increment)
possibleFollowUps: Agent choice: if PLC ignores contradiction, follow with motor-running-without-command disagreement test
If PLC double-counts, follow with duplicate-offer vs sensor-double-count isolation
preconditions: Single-carton context for impossibility oracle; multi-carton exception noted
experiments.verdictLimits: PROBE/exploratory: do not assume one generic alarm required; fail only on false verified claim or double completion.

actions: Hold carton at D1/D2/runout while drive runs (jam); pause WCS heartbeat/messages then resume; break/reconnect OPC UA mid-run
Observe timeout/fault, link state, staleness labels, retry behavior
experiments.decisionLogic: Jam MUST: timeout/fault or equivalent, no invented completion (threshold TBD). Link/transport PROBE: visible link/stale state, runout/hold per policy, no duplicate on retry; stale evidence labeled, no false pass.
experiments.hypothesis: Jams, link loss, and transport interruption are contained and honestly reported.
observations: Position freeze vs RunningFB, Fault_Code, MachineStatus/WCS link, OPC UA quality/timestamps, RouteComplete on retry
possibleFollowUps: If jam completes without exit PE, audit completion logic
If reconnect duplicates completion, follow with idempotency stress
preconditions: Auto, jam/ disconnect injectors armed, trace recording on
experiments.verdictLimits: R-19 MUST except threshold TBD (timing inconclusive). R-20 PROBE. R-21 MUST on no-false-pass with stale labeling.

actions: With spacing < assumed minimum, release two cartons with A then B routes; track per-carton identity through diverts
Observe divert contention, PE overlaps, per-item RouteComplete
experiments.decisionLogic: PROBE/stretch: each carton to one correct exit without identity merge or conflicting timing; acceptable to defer if PLC slice not ready.
experiments.hypothesis: Two close cartons keep identity and reach correct exits.
observations: Per-carton position/ID trace, divert command timing vs both decision points, two RouteCompletes
possibleFollowUps: If merge occurs, follow with single-carton contradiction calibration
If divert contention, follow with spacing sweep to find feasible gap (recorded, not normative)
preconditions: Two-carton capability enabled, both exits ready
experiments.verdictLimits: PROBE/stretch: exploratory; may be marked not-run if PLC slice defers.

faults.activation: Scenario arms when Motor_RunCmd observed true; world withholds Drive_RunningFB true transition.
faults.clearing: Disarm injector; allow delayed feedback on next start; Reset does not auto-restart.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Drive contactor/logic would run but feedback path failed; belt truth remains stopped.
faults.safetyBoundary: Bench fault only; not a safety-rated drive validation.

faults.activation: Scenario asserts Drive_Overload true during travel.
faults.clearing: Deassert overload, require operator Reset, then Start to resume.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Simulated thermal/overcurrent trip; drive truth forced stopped.
faults.safetyBoundary: Functional stop only; not safety-rated E-stop proof.

faults.activation: Scenario holds D1 position at home despite D1_ExtendCmd true.
faults.clearing: Release jam; actuator resumes travel on next command.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: D1 mechanical jam/air loss; ground truth home, PLC sees home/never-both.

faults.activation: Scenario holds D2 position at home despite D2_ExtendCmd true.
Scenario forces both limits true on D1 or D2 regardless of position.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Wiring/shorted limit contradiction; physically impossible, electrically injected.

faults.activation: Scenario emits 20-80ms chatter on PE-ENTRY/D1APP/D2APP during approach window.
faults.clearing: Stop chatter generator; restore geometric derivation.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Optical bounce/contamination chatter sequence; characterized edge list retained as truth.

faults.activation: Scenario holds one PE true or false independent of carton geometry.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Failed/blinded photoeye; truth is geometric occupancy, PLC sees stuck value.

faults.activation: Scenario freezes carton position at D1/D2/runout while belt truth would move.
faults.clearing: Clear obstruction; require Reset per PLC policy.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Physical carton wedge; belt may still indicate running.

faults.activation: Operator scenario sets ExitA_Ready/ExitB_Ready/Runout_Ready false before decision point.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Downstream full/blocked; accumulation count retained as truth.

faults.activation: WCS emulator delays route past decision, duplicates seq, sends conflicting route same item, or pauses heartbeat/disconnects OPC UA.
faults.clearing: Resume normal WCS/transport; duplicate seq remains acked without new carton.
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Upstream/transport irregularity; message log with seq/timestamps is truth.
faults.safetyBoundary: Communication test; stale data must be labeled, motor behavior on disconnect recorded not assumed.

faults.activation: Scenario asserts PE combos impossible for active carton count (e.g., A+B with one carton) or sequence jumps (exit before entry).
faults.injectedGroundTruth: Electrically forced combination/sequence; carton-count context proves impossibility.

evidenceArtifacts: Per-test WCS offer/ack/completion log with seq/item/timestamps
PLC output/status observations with quality/timestamps (Motor_RunCmd, D1/D2 cmds, State/Fault/Counts)
Model state trace: carton positions, divert pct, belt truth, injected fault log
Timing record: task period, OPC UA sample/publish, write/observe latencies, jitter/drops
Verdict table with requirement, injected condition, PLC response, timing, match explanation
failureCriteria: Surrogate carton fails to route by actual divert position, sensors not geometry-derived, or motion occurs without Drive_RunningFB
Ground truth leaked as PLC diagnosis or verdict based on simulator expectation without PLC evidence
Stale/failed transport not labeled or false pass recorded
successCriteria: Surrogate drives A-sort to Exit A, B-sort to Exit B, unassigned to runout, plus one failed-divert or bounce injection and one agent-chosen contradiction follow-up
Each outcome judged from executing surrogate-observed outputs with timestamps/quality and WCS exchange
Timing/limits recorded; TBD thresholds left inconclusive, not scored as pass
firstProofPlan.surrogateScope: Muse-authored world plus clearly labeled software surrogate for PLC decision logic via bench connector ONLY to validate execution contract (state, time evolution, I/O mapping, evidence capture). No CODESYS Control Win in loop.
whatThisDoesNotProve: Real CODESYS PLC integration, OPC UA transport performance, PLC task timing, or HMI vision operation
Production conveyor standards, safety-rated stop/guard, PID, BACnet, or production WCS protocol
Acceptance thresholds still TBD or multi-carton readiness if deferred

invariants.failureMeaning: World invented motion or masked a drive fault; completions untrustworthy.
invariants.statement: Carton position integrates only when observed Motor_RunCmd true AND modeled Drive_RunningFB true; Stop/fault-stop freezes positions.
invariants.validation: Check position delta zero whenever RunningFB false; cross-check Motor_RunCmd vs RunningFB vs Drive_Overload trace.

invariants.failureMeaning: Sort claim bypassed physics; misroute hidden.
invariants.statement: Actual divert position pct at decision instant determines exit; requested route never overrides it.
invariants.validation: Log divert pct at D1/D2 crossing vs commanded route vs observed exit PE.

invariants.failureMeaning: Normal jackpot mis-scored as fault or successful sort.
invariants.statement: Each carton transfers to exactly one of Exit A, Exit B, Runout; unassigned runout is normal, A/B-assigned runout is misroute with Misroute count.
invariants.validation: Single PE-EXIT/RUNOUT passage per carton ID; RouteComplete disposition matches assignment history.

invariants.failureMeaning: Feed/stop contract violated; line drained or auto-restarted.
invariants.statement: Operator Stop inhibits new feed and holds cartons; Reset alone never restarts belt or clears cause.
invariants.validation: ReleaseReady false during Stop/Faulted until Start; Motor_RunCmd stays false after Reset alone.

invariants.failureMeaning: Verdict based on simulator wish, not controller evidence.
invariants.statement: No completion/count without corresponding observed exit PE and PLC-reported RouteComplete/count increment; no invented pass.
invariants.validation: Require exit PE edge + PLC status/count evidence per completion.

invariants.failureMeaning: Diagnosis leaked or masked; report conflates truth and observation.
invariants.statement: Injected ground truth (jam position, suppressed feedback, forced limits/PE, WCS log) is stored separately from PLC-observable DI/WCS/HMI streams.
invariants.validation: Evidence timeline has separate ground-truth lane vs PLC-observation lane with quality/timestamps.

invariants.failureMeaning: Impossible called on legitimate multi-carton overlap.
invariants.statement: Single carton cannot occupy two exits nor one divert report home+extended; with two cartons multiple PEs/both commands may be legitimately true; oracle uses carton count/timing.
invariants.validation: Gate impossibility checks on active carton count and position windows.

name: Conveyor Bench Reactive World - Demo Baseline
objective: Model external physics, WCS peer, faults, and evidence for one-belt two-divert runout machine so CODESYS PLC logic under test can be judged on start/stop, assignment, timing, divert command/feedback, jam/fault, WCS handshake, and indications without reimplementing PLC decisions.

parameters.rationale: Visualization default from spec; determines PE occupancy length.
Visualization default; actual motion gated by Drive_RunningFB.
Each actuator nonzero travel per spec; D1 and D2 separately configured.
Minimum gap for two-carton scenario; not an acceptance limit.
Beam width needed to derive edges from geometry; tune against model/PLC.
Delayed running feedback after Motor_RunCmd; suppressible on failure.
Must configure/record PLC task period, OPC UA sampling/publishing, write/observe latency, jitter, drops.
parameters.value: to measure; CODESYS default sampling 100ms noted

parameters.rationale: Longitudinal coordinates for entry, approach windows, decisions, exits to make lead-time testable.
parameters.value: entry 0.0, D1win 1.0-1.4, D1dec 1.4, D2win 2.2-2.6, D2dec 2.6, runout 3.4, exits branch at decisions

reactiveBehaviors.condition: If Drive_Overload true then RunningFB false; if feedback-suppress fault armed then stay false.
evidenceToRecord: Motor_RunCmd edge time, RunningFB edge time, overload edge, quality
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Model actual drive feedback delay separate from command.
stateChanges: Drive_RunningFB false->true after start delay when commanded and healthy; true->false after stop delay or immediately on overload/stop
reactiveBehaviors.timing: Evaluated each model tick (e.g., 10ms); delays are configuration not acceptance limits.
reactiveBehaviors.trigger: Change in observed Motor_RunCmd or overload/fault injection

reactiveBehaviors.condition: Only when belt_is_running_actual true; else delta zero even if command true but feedback false.
evidenceToRecord: Position trace per carton ID, RunningFB during motion, freeze intervals
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Move cartons only with actual drive feedback; freeze on Stop.
stateChanges: carton_position_m += P-BELT-SPEED * dt when running; else unchanged; jam F-08 can hold individual carton
reactiveBehaviors.trigger: Model tick while cartons on belt

reactiveBehaviors.condition: Occupancy = carton interval [pos, pos+len] overlaps sensor point +/- beam/2 and carton is on corresponding lane/branch.
evidenceToRecord: PE edges with position and timestamp
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Derive photoeyes from geometry unless stuck/bounce/contradiction fault overrides.
stateChanges: None (derived); override only via explicit F-06/F-07/F-11 injector state
reactiveBehaviors.timing: Recomputed after each motion update; bounce injector emits characterized edge list.
reactiveBehaviors.trigger: Carton movement or fault injector change

reactiveBehaviors.condition: Ramp toward 0% when ExtendCmd false, 100% when true; jam holds at current despite command.
evidenceToRecord: ExtendCmd edges, position pct trace, limit transitions
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Enforce nonzero actuator travel and limit feedback truth.
stateChanges: divert1/2_position_pct integrates over P-DIV-TRAVEL; HomeFB true iff pct<5%, ExtendedFB true iff pct>95% unless F-05 forces both true
reactiveBehaviors.timing: Each tick; travel time configurable per divert.

reactiveBehaviors.condition: At D1 decision: if divert1 pct>95% route to Exit A branch else stay main; at D2 decision: if divert2 pct>95% route to Exit B else stay main to runout.
evidenceToRecord: Decision timestamps, divert pct at crossing, requested vs actual exit
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Actual divert position at decision point determines exit.
stateChanges: carton lane assigned to A-branch, B-branch, or main-runout; exactly one terminal exit per carton
reactiveBehaviors.trigger: Carton leading edge reaches DIV-01 or DIV-02 decision point

reactiveBehaviors.condition: Release only if State Auto and ReleaseReady observed true and spacing >= P-SPACING-MIN and not Stop/Faulted/blocked-hold; valid WCS destination not required when runout available.
evidenceToRecord: Release time, spacing check, ReleaseReady, offer seq/item
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Gate virtual feeder on PLC readiness and space; inhibit on Stop/fault/hold.
stateChanges: Create carton ID/position/length/route; set wcs pending acked; duplicate seq creates nothing
reactiveBehaviors.timing: On release request; late route after decision never retroactively reroutes.
reactiveBehaviors.trigger: Feeder release request from scenario or WCS flow

reactiveBehaviors.condition: If ExitA/B/Runout_Ready false, cartons routed there accumulate; if runout blocked and no destination, assert hold (feed inhibit + belt stop expectation).
evidenceToRecord: Readiness driven values, accumulation counts, hold condition
reactiveBehaviors.purpose: Model downstream capacity and blocked-route backpressure.
